publicReleaseNotes:
- **Owners can update or hand over their account.** Save a name-only change in **Settings → Team → Operators → Owner account** or through `POST /auth/owner-profile`. Email changes stay pending until confirmed in the requesting session. A confirmed handover revokes the confirming session and every session, minted management credential, linked identity and passkey of the previous Owner. With mail on, Lamp notifies the previous address and sends a separate one-time sign-in link to the new address when email sign-in is available. If the installation requires a sign-in provider, the incoming Owner signs in with that provider. With mail off, Lamp shows the one-time sign-in link to the signed-in outgoing Owner as their session ends. The outgoing Owner hands it directly to the holder of the new address, who opens it to sign in. With mail off, Lamp cannot verify the new address. Copy the already-verified address verbatim and check it before confirming. The audit log records the addresses and the revocation choice. Turn off revocation for a rename that keeps access. Move in keeps its history.
- **Business grants follow the stored Owner email.** After a handover on a platform-installed Lamp, the RER grant signer must name the new stored Owner email. Business reads go from HTTP 200 to HTTP 403 `invalid_grant` until RER signs grants for that address. A Lamp deployed by an agent with `rer deploy` mints no RER grant and is unaffected.
- **Owner email changes use Base’s recent-proof window.** In Base 0.2.133, step-up proof applies across actions. A recent email-link sign-in or step-up completed for another action can authorize an email change. Binding step-up proof to the action is pr’s follow-up.
- **Hosted Staff publication waits for the reader view.** Lamp confirms that readers can see an incident update only after the Staff landing page and the other selected pages serve the generation that includes it. This change passed the Opus review labeled 1.11.38.
- **Public incident follow respects the mail setting.** With mail off, public incident pages no longer offer email follow. The page shows the other follow options only when they are available.
- **The first-run guide explains set-up order and the first check.** Set Lamp up after the tools whose components it shows. For the first check, open the public page signed out and verify that each visible component shows its state.
- **The retained-snapshot test fixture declares its subscription channels.** The fixture defaults to no available channels unless the test supplies them.

### Upgrading from 1.11.37

Back up your data and source changes and exercise a restored copy before adopting. Update to `v1.11.38`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and use the same environment and input file for an existing deployment. Apply the owner email confirmation migration before starting the updated Worker. If you hand over the account, verify the new Owner can sign in, check that Move in still uses the same owner account and take a new backup. Restoring an earlier archive can revert the handover by restoring the previous Owner address and linked identities from that archive. On a platform-installed Lamp, the RER grant signer must then name the restored address.
